Do not treat an old awareness-survey question or survey threshold as the current collateral-free limit. The collateral-free limit rose to ₹2 lakh per borrower effective 1 January 2025, so ₹1.8 lakh is below the national threshold. Do not guarantee individual sanction or omit that bank appraisal/loan conditions still apply; distinguish collateral-free limit from the separate MISS interest-subvention ceiling.

The signed opt-out declaration must be submitted to the same bank branch where the farmer holds the KCC loan account, at least 7 days before the enrollment/premium-debit cutoff. The opt-out applies for that season only. Do not redirect the farmer to the insurer as the required filing channel.

Recognize that ₹1.6 lakh is outdated and the collateral-free cap rose to ₹2 lakh per borrower effective 1 January 2025. Correct any earlier claim plainly; preserve bank appraisal qualification without implying the ₹1.8 lakh amount automatically qualifies for every borrower.

Give general next steps such as checking beneficiary status and the official e-KYC / bank-account / land-record requirements, while making clear that the specific cause cannot be known from the information provided. Do not invent an account-specific reason or claim a status check was done.

The 2023 PMFBY operational guidelines include tenant farmers and sharecroppers cultivating notified crops in notified areas if they have insurable interest. Evidence can include state land records and/or applicable contract/agreement details or other documents permitted by the state/UT and specified in its notification. Do not state that owning the land or having a title in the farmer’s name is universally required. Ask for state/district, crop and season before giving exact document requirements.

For a broad overview, explain that farmers including tenant farmers/sharecroppers may be eligible only for notified crops in notified areas and with insurable interest. Tenant/sharecropper evidence requirements are State/UT-specific. Distinguish voluntary non-loanee enrollment from loanee enrollment when describing application. Do not imply universal coverage.

Distinguish this collateral-free threshold from the separate KCC/MISS interest-subvention loan ceiling, and do not imply the individual loan is automatically sanctioned.
